explanation: Penta is Greek for five. Pentatonic scales turn up in folk music from Scotland to China and West Africa, and the five black keys of a piano octave form one.

claims.text: A major scale has seven different notes in each octave.
A pentatonic scale has five different notes in each octave.
Penta is the Greek for five.
Pentatonic scales are found in folk music in many parts of the world, including Scotland, China and West Africa.
The five black keys in a piano octave form a pentatonic scale.
